title: Codewars 8kyu: Multiply
description: This code does not execute properly. Try to figure out why and return the product of `a` and `b`.
starter_code:
def multiply(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    pass
solution:
def multiply(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a * b
explanation: Multiplies two numbers in O(1) time.
